presets.label: Light
presets.note: ClickHouse wins the heavy queries 1.4–6×, but at 10–80 ms on Postgres everything still feels instant. Postgres wins the queries that touch only a few rows.

presets.label: Standard
presets.note: Heavy queries: Postgres ~20–400 ms vs ClickHouse ~9–40 ms (up to 13×). Postgres still wins the queries that touch only a few rows.

presets.label: Large
presets.note: Heavy queries: Postgres ~0.1–3 s vs ClickHouse ~13–150 ms (up to 22×). The gap is plainly felt.
presets.warning: Uses about 620 MB of disk (up to ~760 MB for a few seconds while loading), almost 4× the default size.
